title: 'Everything Is Dead': Ukraine Liberates Dnipropetrovsk Settlements, But Villages Lie In Ruins
content:
Ukraine’s forces have retaken 26 settlements in the 
Dnipropetrovsk region, but the villages are largely destroyed and uninhabitable. As Russian troops are pushed back, Ukrainian forces face the challenge of holding the reclaimed territory under constant threat from drones.

title: Funeral Held For Five Children From One Ukrainian Family Killed In Russian Strike In July
content: A funeral was held in Radushne in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk Region on October 19 for five children from one family who were killed in an air strike on July 30. Their burial was delayed as investigators used DNA analysis to identify the victims. Five other family members had already been laid to rest.
